sha256-hdi-v1:142b8c63cc0dc96f7fcac2a711.description: Three free generals must reclaim Hyunckel's castles and rescue companions captured by dark forces. The sequel focuses on turn-based tactical campaigns across a fantasy kingdom.
sha256-hdi-v1:142b8c63cc0dc96f7fcac2a711.title: Shangrlia 2

sha256-hdi-v1:14ccae5da061fa8c251e070867.description: Witch Mesaana has cursed the people of Strawberry Fields, turning some into monsters. Takeru searches three dungeons for sacred writings that can undo the spell in this fantasy RPG sequel.
sha256-hdi-v1:14ccae5da061fa8c251e070867.title: Dragon Knight II

sha256-hdi-v1:14e38003211a1c1c1cfc69fff3.description: The tenth installment is a roughly ten-minute animated story set at a bathhouse. Unlike the earlier episodes, it has essentially no player interaction.
sha256-hdi-v1:14e38003211a1c1c1cfc69fff3.title: Jewel Bem Hunter Lime Vol. 10
